headlines.title: 上海：加快推进收购二手住房用作保障性租赁住房
headlines.summary: 8月20日，上海市住房城乡建设管理委、市房屋管理局、市财政局、人民银行上海市分行、上海金融监管局、市公积金管理中心等六部门联合印发《关于优化本市房地产政策措施的通知》，自2026年8月21日起施行。《通知》规定，以需求为导向，结合“十五五”时期保障性租赁住房发展要求，各中心城区（含浦东外环内区域）推进二手住房收购工作，并加快改造出租，切实增加中心城区保障性租赁住房供应。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Accelerating the purchase of second-hand homes for use as affordable rental housing
headlines.summary_en: On August 20, six Shanghai departments, including the Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Development Commission, the Municipal Housing Administration Bureau, the Municipal Finance Bureau, the PBOC Shanghai Branch, the Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau, and the Municipal Housing Provident Fund Management Center, jointly issued the "Notice on Optimizing the City's Real Estate Policy Measures," effective from August 21, 2026. The Notice stipulates a demand-oriented approach, aligned with the requirements for affordable rental housing development during the "15th Five-Year Plan" period, promoting the acquisition of second-hand homes in central urban areas (including areas inside the Outer Ring Road in Pudong), accelerating renovation for rental purposes, and effectively increasing the supply of affordable rental housing in central urban areas.

headlines.title: 上海出台楼市“沪八条”
headlines.summary: 为更好满足居民刚性和改善性住房需求，促进房地产市场平稳健康发展，8月20日，上海市住房城乡建设管理委、市房屋管理局、市财政局、人民银行上海市分行、上海金融监管局、市公积金管理中心等六部门联合印发《关于优化本市房地产政策措施的通知》（以下简称《通知》），自2026年8月21日起施行。《通知》主要包括优化住房公积金提取、优化个人住房信贷、实施“以旧换新”购房补贴、推行房票安置以及推进收购二手住房等5个方面8项政策措施。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai introduces 'Shanghai Eight Measures' for the property market
headlines.summary_en: To better meet residents' rigid and improved housing needs and promote the stable and healthy development of the real estate market, on August 20, six Shanghai departments, including the Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Development Commission, the Municipal Housing Administration Bureau, the Municipal Finance Bureau, the PBOC Shanghai Branch, the Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau, and the Municipal Housing Provident Fund Management Center, jointly issued the "Notice on Optimizing the City's Real Estate Policy Measures" (hereinafter referred to as the "Notice"), effective from August 21, 2026. The Notice mainly includes 8 policy measures in 5 areas: optimizing housing provident fund withdrawals, optimizing personal housing credit, implementing "trade-in" home purchase subsidies, promoting housing voucher resettlement, and advancing the acquisition of second-hand homes.

headlines.title: 上海：扩大支付购房首付款提取范围，继续支持“既提又贷”
headlines.summary: 8月20日，上海市住房城乡建设管理委、市房屋管理局、市财政局、人民银行上海市分行、上海金融监管局、市公积金管理中心等六部门联合印发《关于优化本市房地产政策措施的通知》，自2026年8月21日起施行。其中提出，扩大支付购房首付款提取范围。在2025年8月“沪六条”支持缴存人购买本市新建预售商品住房提取住房公积金支付首付款的基础上，进一步扩大住房公积金支付购房首付款范围至购买新建商品住房现房；同时继续支持“既提又贷”，缴存人提取支付首付款后不影响其公积金贷款额度计算。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Expanding the scope of housing advance payment withdrawals, continuing to support 'both withdrawal and loan'
headlines.summary_en: On August 20, six Shanghai departments, including the Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Development Commission, the Municipal Housing Administration Bureau, the Municipal Finance Bureau, the PBOC Shanghai Branch, the Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau, and the Municipal Housing Provident Fund Management Center, jointly issued the "Notice on Optimizing the City's Real Estate Policy Measures," effective from August 21, 2026. It proposes expanding the scope of withdrawal for down payment payments. Building on the August 2025 "Shanghai Six Measures" that supported contributors in withdrawing housing provident funds to pay down payments on newly built pre-sold commercial housing, this further expands the scope of housing provident fund withdrawals for down payments to newly built commercial housing that is already completed; it also continues to support "both withdrawal and lending," where contributors' withdrawal of down payments does not affect their provident fund loan amount calculation.

headlines.title: 上海：实施“以旧换新”购房贷款补贴
headlines.summary: 8月20日，上海市住房城乡建设管理委、市房屋管理局、市财政局、人民银行上海市分行、上海金融监管局、市公积金管理中心等六部门联合印发《关于优化本市房地产政策措施的通知》，自2026年8月21日起施行。其中提出，实施“以旧换新”购房贷款补贴。在本《通知》实施之日起至2027年3月31日，居民家庭在本市外环外购买新建商品住房并完成合同网签备案，且在网签备案日前后1年内出售本市二手住房的，可向购入新建商品住房所在区房地产交易中心申请补贴。补贴金额按购买新建商品住房贷款总额的1%计算，单套住房最高补贴5万元；补贴总金额2亿元，用完即止。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Implementing 'trade-in' housing purchase loan subsidies
headlines.summary_en: On August 20, six Shanghai departments, including the Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Development Commission, the Municipal Housing Administration Bureau, the Municipal Finance Bureau, the PBOC Shanghai Branch, the Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau, and the Municipal Housing Provident Fund Management Center, jointly issued the "Notice on Optimizing the City's Real Estate Policy Measures," effective from August 21, 2026. It proposes implementing a "trade-in" home purchase loan subsidy. From the effective date of this Notice to March 31, 2027, households that purchase newly built commercial housing outside the Outer Ring Road and complete online contract filing, and sell their second-hand home in Shanghai within 1 year before or after the filing date, may apply for a subsidy from the real estate transaction center of the district where the purchased new home is located. The subsidy amount is calculated at 1% of the total loan amount for the newly purchased commercial housing, with a maximum subsidy of RMB 50,000 per unit; the total subsidy fund is RMB 200 million, available on a first-come, first-served basis until exhausted.

headlines.title: 上海：优化房地产政策措施
headlines.summary: 8月20日，上海市住房城乡建设管理委、市房屋管理局、市财政局、人民银行上海市分行、上海金融监管局、市公积金管理中心等六部门联合印发《关于优化本市房地产政策措施的通知》，自2026年8月21日起施行。《通知》明确优化二套房贷首付款比例。对购买外环外（包括原实施差异化政策区域）住房的，二套住房商业性个人住房贷款最低首付款比例从“不低于20%”调整为“不低于15%”。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Optimizing real estate policy measures
headlines.summary_en: On August 20, six Shanghai departments, including the Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Development Commission, the Municipal Housing Administration Bureau, the Municipal Finance Bureau, the PBOC Shanghai Branch, the Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau, and the Municipal Housing Provident Fund Management Center, jointly issued the "Notice on Optimizing the City's Real Estate Policy Measures," effective from August 21, 2026. The Notice clarifies the optimization of the minimum down payment ratio for second-home loans. For purchases of homes outside the Outer Ring Road (including areas previously under differentiated policies), the minimum down payment ratio for second-home commercial personal housing loans is adjusted from "not less than 20%" to "not less than 15%."

headlines.title: 上海：进一步加大房票实施力度
headlines.summary: 8月20日，上海市住房城乡建设管理委、市房屋管理局、市财政局、人民银行上海市分行、上海金融监管局、市公积金管理中心等六部门联合印发《关于优化本市房地产政策措施的通知》，自2026年8月21日起施行。《通知》明确进一步加大房票实施力度，在征收拆迁补偿安置中增加房票安置方式，重点聚焦城中村改造和旧城区改建项目等，统筹平衡现有征收拆迁补偿标准，多种方式满足居民多元化安置需求。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Further strengthening the implementation of housing vouchers
headlines.summary_en: On August 20, six Shanghai departments, including the Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Development Commission, the Municipal Housing Administration Bureau, the Municipal Finance Bureau, the PBOC Shanghai Branch, the Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau, and the Municipal Housing Provident Fund Management Center, jointly issued the "Notice on Optimizing the City's Real Estate Policy Measures," effective from August 21, 2026. The Notice clarifies further strengthening the implementation of housing vouchers, adding housing voucher resettlement as an option in expropriation, demolition, compensation, and resettlement, focusing on urban village redevelopment and old urban area renovation projects, coordinating and balancing existing expropriation and demolition compensation standards, and using multiple methods to meet residents' diversified resettlement needs.

headlines.title: 上海：优化购房提取公积金频次和限额
headlines.summary: 8月20日，上海市住房城乡建设管理委、市房屋管理局、市财政局、人民银行上海市分行、上海金融监管局、市公积金管理中心等六部门联合印发《关于优化本市房地产政策措施的通知》，自2026年8月21日起施行。其中提出，优化购房提取公积金频次和限额。对在我市没有公积金个人住房贷款或未办理公积金冲还贷业务的已购房缴存人，进一步放宽本市购房提取频次和金额，购房提取频次由不动产权证发证之日起5年内“提取一次”调整为“每个自然年提取一次”；购房提取金额放宽至“不超过购买该住房以自有资金支付的购房款”。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Optimizing the frequency and limit of housing fund withdrawals for home purchases
headlines.summary_en: On August 20, six Shanghai departments, including the Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Development Commission, the Municipal Housing Administration Bureau, the Municipal Finance Bureau, the PBOC Shanghai Branch, the Shanghai Financial Regulatory Bureau, and the Municipal Housing Provident Fund Management Center, jointly issued the "Notice on Optimizing the City's Real Estate Policy Measures," effective from August 21, 2026. It proposes optimizing the frequency and limits of housing provident fund withdrawals for home purchases. For contributors who have already purchased homes and have no provident fund personal housing loans or have not applied for provident fund offset repayment services in the city, the frequency and amount of withdrawals for home purchases are further relaxed. The withdrawal frequency is adjusted from "withdraw once" within 5 years from the issuance date of the real estate ownership certificate to "withdraw once per calendar year"; the withdrawal amount is relaxed to "not exceeding the purchase price of the home paid with self-owned funds."

headlines.title: 上海：出台阶段性购房补贴政策
headlines.summary: 一是实施“以旧换新”购房贷款补贴。在本《通知》实施之日起至2027年3月31日，居民家庭在本市外环外购买新建商品住房并完成合同网签备案，且在网签备案日前后1年内出售本市二手住房的，可向购入新建商品住房所在区房地产交易中心申请补贴。补贴金额按购买新建商品住房贷款总额的1%计算，单套住房最高补贴5万元；补贴总金额2亿元，用完即止。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Introducing phased home purchase subsidy policies
headlines.summary_en: First, implementing a "trade-in" home purchase loan subsidy. From the effective date of this Notice to March 31, 2027, households that purchase newly built commercial housing outside the Outer Ring Road and complete online contract filing, and sell their second-hand home in Shanghai within 1 year before or after the filing date, may apply for a subsidy from the real estate transaction center of the district where the purchased new home is located. The subsidy amount is calculated at 1% of the total loan amount for the newly purchased commercial housing, with a maximum subsidy of RMB 50,000 per unit; the total subsidy fund is RMB 200 million, available on a first-come, first-served basis until exhausted.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai releases 8 new property policies today: Precise measures, with a phased maximum subsidy of 80,000 yuan for 'selling old and buying new'
headlines.summary_en: Shanghai Unveils 8 New Property Market Policies: Targeted Measures, Up to 80,000 Yuan Subsidy for 'Sell Old, Buy New' Phase. After a six-month hiatus, Shanghai has introduced new property policies. On August 20, six departments including the Shanghai Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Development Commission, the Municipal Housing Management Bureau, and the Municipal Finance Bureau jointly issued the 'Notice on Optimizing Property Market Policies and Measures in Our City,' launching eight measures covering provident funds, personal housing loans, trade-ins, housing ticket resettlement, and second-hand home purchases. The new policies take effect from August 21.

headlines.title_en: Shanghai: Optimizing housing provident fund withdrawal policies.
headlines.summary_en: First, expand the scope for withdrawing funds to pay down payments. Based on the August 2025 'Shanghai Six Measures' supporting depositors in purchasing new pre-sold commercial housing in the city with provident fund withdrawals for down payments, the scope is further expanded to include purchasing new commercial housing with existing stock; simultaneously, continue to support 'both withdrawal and loan,' where withdrawing funds for down payments does not affect the calculation of provident fund loan limits.
